capabilities: prefix new note names with today's date
configure the date format, separator, and default note name
delay renaming so Templater templates process first
extras: Has a troubleshooting section covering renamed notes not appearing and conflicts with Templater; installable via BRAT.
problem: New Obsidian notes are named "Untitled", so users who want dated note names must rename each one manually.

relations.evidence: Templater: A 500ms delay ensures templates are processed before renaming
QuickAdd: Works seamlessly with QuickAdd note creation

summary: Plugin that automatically prefixes new note names with today's date using a configurable Moment.js format.
